verdict.rationale: Exa's API clearly exposes search, extraction, structured output, websets, scheduling, and webhooks (exa-docs-7,8,9,10,21), and the dashboard is described as a UI for the same websets functionality, suggesting rough parity — but there's no explicit statement or independent test confirming that every dashboard action (e.g., visual query building, verification UI) is fully replicable via API calls, nor any negative evidence of API-only or UI-only gaps.  missing for 10: explicit vendor statement of full API/UI feature parity, and independent hands-on confirmation that all dashboard actions map to API endpoints.
